qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for M12x1.25 spark plugs?
What is the torque specification for M14x1.25 spark plugs?
What section number covers spark plugs in the Engine Electrical System?
What is the difference in torque between M12x1.25 and M14x1.25 spark plugs?
qa_pairs.answer: The M14x1.25 spark plugs require 7 Nm more torque (30 ± 3 Nm) compared to M12x1.25 spark plugs (23 ± 3 Nm).

qa_pairs.question: What condition are the spark plugs specified for in this table?
Do both spark plug specifications apply to all vehicle types?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, both M12x1.25 and M14x1.25 spark plug torque specifications apply to 'All' vehicle types.
